notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Completed 2-week Hosted API trial (Jan 29 - Feb 11). Team is happy with quality; main ask now is Dedicated capacity sizing and firm pricing for committed throughput.

Trial highlights:
- Models evaluated: redwood-13B-quant (default), llama-7b-compat for embeddings.
- Observed latency: p50 ~110ms, p95 ~220ms on Hosted API during internal load tests.
- Request mix: chat ~60%, embeddings ~25%, rerank ~15%.
- Token profile (trial): average prompt tokens: 130; average completion tokens: 340; average total per request: ~470 tokens.
- Traffic during trial: avg QPS ~0.8 (low internal tests), peak observed 12 QPS during demo week.
- Business forecast (customer provided): launch month target = avg 30 QPS, expected growth to avg 60 QPS within 3 months post-launch, peak bursts up to 150 QPS for promotional events.

Dedicated sizing asks (from infra/product):
- Recommended GPU equivalent: want guidance whether 4x A10G or 2x A100-s at target token mix.
- Need concurrency guidance: product expects 50 concurrent chat sessions (each streaming).
- KV cache and prefix caching importance: majority of requests reuse prompts for personalization - want caching strategy to reduce tokens/sec.
- Cost sensitivity: prefers tradeoff leaning toward lower latency but needs clear $/1M tokens compare between hosted vs dedicated commit tiers.

POC / Commercial cadence:
- 2026-02-02: hosted API demo + architecture review (Jordan + Priya + Halo infra). Fireflies: ff_20260218_7b9e2a (full transcript).
- 2026-02-11: hosted trial conclusion: internal execs signaled positive QA on model outputs.
- 2026-02-25: pricing intro call; Halo requests committed monthly baseline and a burst window.
- 2026-03-03: security questionnaire submitted (Halo_Sec_Questionnaire_v1). Legal flagged EU data residency for key customers.

Technical notes / numbers for sizing estimate (asked of Redwood):
- Baseline forecast (month 0 = launch): avg 30 QPS, 95th 85 QPS, expected token/sec at avg: ~14k tokens/sec (based on 470 tokens/request).
- Month 3 forecast: avg 60 QPS, 95th 180 QPS, tokens/sec peak ~84k tokens/sec during promo bursts.
- Embedding volume: 25% of requests, small token count (avg 12 tokens) but heavy throughput for batch embedding jobs run nightly.

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + SOC2 attestation.
- KMS integration required for keys used in logs/audit export.
- Data residency: EU subset of tenants must have inference processing in EU region or on Dedicated Private deployment.

Sales / Commercial notes:
- Halo is mid-market, willing to commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract if pricing shows ~40-60% improvement vs hosted pay-as-you-go at forecasted volume.
- Procurement wants clear definition of burst policy and overage rates.
- CSM involvement planned after contract close to onboard and establish runbooks.

1) Provide concrete Dedicated SKU options (GPU counts/types) + expected QPS and tokens/sec capacity per SKU with target token mix.
2) Clarify burst capacity latency SLOs and automatic fallback (hosted vs cheaper variants) behavior.
3) Provide sample cost model with 3 scenarios: conservative, expected, optimistic (token counts and QPS).
4) Confirm timeline for KMS/HSM integration and EU residency options for Dedicated Private deployment.

- Priya: prepare pre-flight sizing doc + sample cost model (due 2026-03-12).
